Title: War with the House of Saul
KeyPersons: King David; Joab; Abner, Son of Ner; Ish-bosheth, Son of Saul
Events: After Saul's death David rules Judah from Hebron while Ish-bosheth rules the north, and a long civil war follows until Abner and then Ish-bosheth are murdered and all Israel turns to David.
